raw_segments.text: Charmian, our worser thoughts heavens mend. Alexis, come, his fortune, his fortune. O,
let him marry a woman that cannot go, sweet Isis, I beseech thee, and let her die too,
and give him a worse, and let worse follow worse, till the worst of all follow him laughing
to his grave, fifty-fold a-cuckled. Good Isis, hear me this prayer, though thou deny
me a matter of more weight. Good Isis, I beseech thee.
